title: Check yourself: what a resource must be

questions.stem: Per this page, what must a type implement before its objects can be declared in a try-with-resources header?

options.text: `Serializable`, so that the statement can save its state
options.says: The page says a resource must implement AutoCloseable; saving state plays no part in closing it.

options.text: `Iterable`, so that the statement can visit each part
options.says: The page says a resource must implement AutoCloseable, whose close() is called when the block exits.

options.text: `AutoCloseable`, whose one method the statement calls
options.says: The page says a resource must implement AutoCloseable, which defines the single close() method called automatically.
